show.description: After a devastating earthquake tears her family apart, Meera is forced into an impossible choice that changes three lives forever. Years later, hidden identities, class divides, and buried guilt collide when fate brings the separated daughters back into each other’s world. As shocking truths unravel, love, betrayal, and sacrifice redefine what family truly means.
